title: Corrupt payroll export sent as an attachment

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Attached is the September payroll export — Excel says the file is corrupt and won't open it. Can you fix it? Payroll runs on the 25th.

Mel

attachments.shows: Salary, bank and NI details for 212 employees

handling.escalation_reason: File recovery needs a person, and the file is payroll data that should not be passed around.

rationale: No runbook for file recovery. The attachment is payroll data; the agent only sees its name, which is as it should be. Whether sending it to the helpdesk is itself a data-handling incident is a policy question for the reviewer — labelled not security-sensitive here.
